name: Watase Itsuki
source:
When his father remarried a year ago, he became family with the Watase family. Because they were all beautiful women, he spends his day agonizing over his feelings.

He worked hard to keep his libido in check. but when he found out his father was having an affair. he decided he didn't need to hold back anymore and starts to conquer his family.

He had a bit of a delinquent past that he didn't tell his family about.
